text:
morgan: Quick question — should canary rollouts allow fully automatic fallback on service errors, or require operator confirmation?

jess: I'd be ok with auto for clear-cut failures but only if the UI makes actions visible and reversible. no silent flips.

samir: idea: auto-trigger + short cooldown + notif + 1-click revert. sample policy: 

```yaml
fallback_policy:
  triggers:
    - name: http_5xx_spike
      expr: rate(http_5xx[1m]) > 0.05
      window: 60s
      occurrences: 3
    - name: latency_tail
      expr: p95_request_latency_ms > 1200
      window: 3m
  mode: soft_degrade    # hard_switch | soft_degrade | sample_redirect
  cool_down: 120s
  audit_retention_days: 90
```

morgan: what does soft_degrade mean for traffic?

jess: divert a small percentage (eg 25%) to fallback model/region and keep remainder on canary for visibility. less blast radius.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary 2024-02-16T12:14:05Z: spikes detected. Suggested action: soft_degrade -> 25% redirect.

taylor: UX needs: 1) timeline of triggers + metric values, 2) "Why" that shows the rule and last matching samples, 3) cost/latency delta estimate when degraded.

leo: add hysteresis to avoid oscillation and require min degraded duration before auto-revert. tag every fallback with event_id and reason.

samir: telemetry: emit fallback events to tracing and alerts, include trace_id, keep request samples for QA.

jess: UI mock: toast says "Auto-degraded: soft (25%) due to p95 > 1200ms — Undo | Details". Details side panel shows trigger eval, last 10 samples, buttons: revert, increase degrade, mark as known.

morgan: defaults — enable auto-fallback for new tenants? my vote: enabled with conservative defaults, allow opt-out in onboarding.

taylor: expose telemetry sampling rate and forwarding options per-tenant.

leo: event schema suggestion (compact, searchable): event_id, ts, rollout_id, trigger_name, mode, percent, metrics_snapshot, operator.

morgan: next steps?

jess: 1) UI toast + details mock (taylor)
2) implement cool_down + hysteresis in policy engine (samir)
3) audit event schema + tracing hook (leo)
4) conservative default policy for new tenants + opt-out (product)

samir: I'll prototype a policy schema and run a small simulator to show oscillation risk.

taylor: I'll build a two-panel mock and toast flow.

morgan: great, reconvene after mocks/protos. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [audit-bot] Fallback events retained for 90 days by default (configurable).

jess: can someone add a two-bullet runbook for oncall for when auto-degrade triggers?

leo: I'll drop a short runbook snippet into this thread tomorrow.

morgan: thanks all.
